name: Cover: Warm Keynote
description: A Keynote-style cover: on grid paper, a short teal rule leading into the series name, one line of 900-weight headline (the keyword turns teal) and one line of subtitle; bottom left the progress ticks (one per page, the current one lit), bottom right the page number pill. Title and subtitle are single lines and shrink automatically when too long. A centred title slide would lose the left-aligned rhythm and the product feel the page furniture gives.

brand.hint: series or product name after the teal rule, filled automatically from the series name of the story title (before the colon)

title.hint: claim headline, single line, up to 16 characters; *keyword* turns the emphasis teal

subtitle.hint: a one-line subtitle, up to 45 characters

brand.value: Confirm the story before the slides

title.value: Spend time on the *story*, not layout

subtitle.value: Six decks averaged four rounds last quarter, three layout only; confirm the story first and they vanish.
